name: io.github.rthomas24/webvector
title: WebVector
description: Web research for AI agents: search, read pages, rank, return cited passages. Local, keyless, MIT.

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_SEARCH_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Search provider: duckduckgo (default, keyless) | brave | serper | tavily | exa | perplexity | searxng | serpapi | google-cse

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embeddings: auto (default) | none (lexical BM25) | local | openai | gemini | voyage | cohere | mistral | jina | ollama

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_STORE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: ephemeral (default) | session | persistent — whether pages are reused across calls

environmentVariables.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Brave Search API key (optional; enables the brave search provider)

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key (optional; enables semantic retrieval with OpenAI embeddings)

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_MCP_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Default token budget per result (500–20000, default 4000)

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_MCP_MAX_USES
environmentVariables.description: Refuse further web tool calls after this many (guardrail)

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_MCP_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains the server may search/fetch (guardrail)

environmentVariables.name: WEBVECTOR_MCP_BLOCKED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains the server never searches/fetches (guardrail)
